proof_kind: Written mathematical proofs with source-operation range arguments and independent review; no formal proof-assistant or compiler-verification claim.
runtime_quantifier: Every finite prefix admitted by the contract, with no fixed lifetime horizon.

lemmas.name: Exact bounded charge
premises: int32 current m and uint32 tick count t
Initial P and every exact prefix belong to the fixed int64 interval [L,U]
lemmas.claim: Stored P equals P_0+sum(m_k*t_k) for every admitted prefix; no runtime-dependent arithmetic error.
proof: The product range is [-2^63+2^31,2^63-2^32-2^31+1], inside int64. Both operands are cast to int64 before multiplication.
For p>0, INT64_MAX-p is representable; P<=INT64_MAX-p prevents positive overflow. For p<0, INT64_MIN-p is representable; P>=INT64_MIN-p prevents negative overflow.
Only after these checks is exact P+p computed and checked against [L,U]. All errors precede commitment.
Initialization establishes exactness. Each accepted update preserves it, so induction proves the claim for every admitted prefix. There is no lifetime count or increasing auxiliary total.
limits: Represented inputs only
Physical scale conversion and SOC query not implemented
Unbounded positive throughput is outside the bounded-prefix premise
Rejected inputs are not propagated

lemmas.name: Outward integer exponential attenuation
premises: q=num/den>=0 with uint32 num and den>0
lemmas.claim: 0<=A_lo/D<=exp(-q)<=A_hi/D<=1, with fixed bounded work and no libm.
proof: q=0 returns [D,D]. For q>=32, e>2 gives exp(-q)<1/D, so [0,1]/D encloses the result.
For q<32, (uint64)num<<32 is at most2^64-2^32. Exact floor/ceiling division encloses D*q, with upper<=32D.
At most eight outward halvings enclose x=q/2^s in [0,1/8].
For P_r=sum_{j=0}^r(-x)^j/j!, the integral remainder is (-1)^(r+1)/r! times integral_0^x exp(-t)*(x-t)^r dt. Thus P7<=exp(-x)<=P6.
Outward interval powers and directed factorial division enclose each polynomial. Positive and negative terms select the corresponding outward endpoints.
Intersect with the proved range [0,D]. Monotone outward squaring s times encloses exp(-q).

For Q32 multiplication, operands equal to D are handled as exact unity. Otherwise a*b<2^64; high bits give floor and a nonzero low part adds one for ceiling. All polynomial sums fit int64; ceil_div uses quotient plus remainder indicator.
limits: Only the encoded ratio is covered
A_hi=D can occur for positive q
Target division timing and compiler correctness are not established

lemmas.name: Bounded dissipative-state enclosure
premises: Real x in [l,u] and exact integer target b in [-B,B]
lemmas.claim: The output interval encloses every x_next=a*x+(1-a)*b and stays in [-B,B] for every admitted prefix. Exact unity is an exact identity.
proof: The expression is bilinear in a and x. Its extrema on the rectangle occur at the four endpoint combinations.
Every corner numerator N=A*x+(D-A)*b has magnitude<=D*B<=2^62. Each product and their exact sum are representable in int64.
C99 signed quotient/remainder correction computes floor(minN/D) and ceil(maxN/D), enclosing the full rectangle image.
Every corner is a convex combination in [-B,B]. The integer domain boundaries cannot be crossed by outward rounding. The range and containment invariants follow by induction.

For A_lo=A_hi=D, the numerators equal D*x; division is exact. The complete state interval is unchanged for any number of identity updates. After all validation the implementation returns without writing, also preserving any ABI padding.
limits: Exact integer target is assumed
Initial containment must be justified
Scalar recurrence only; coupled sensitivities and state transport require separate arguments

lemmas.name: Conditional width bound independent of runtime
premises: Arbitrary exact identity updates may intervene
lemmas.claim: W_n<=min(2B,max(W_0,(2B*h+2D)/g)) in grid units for every prefix; n may count only active updates.
proof: Since |x'-b|<=2B, the unrounded image width is at most (A_hi/D)*W+2B*(A_hi-A_lo)/D.
Outward endpoint rounding adds less than two units, so W_next<=(1-g/D)*W+(2B*h/D)+2.
Geometric-series induction bounds W_n by rho^n*W_0+(2B*h/D+2)*(1-rho^n)/(1-rho), rho=1-g/D, hence by max(W_0,(2B*h+2D)/g). L3 supplies the additional2B bound.
Exact identity updates add no width and do not alter the recurrence over active updates.
lemmas.usefulness_gate: The state quantum times the bound must meet a justified application tolerance. No physical tolerance is selected in this checkpoint.
limits: A_hi=D on an active update violates the strict-contraction premise
Nominal 35Hz alone gives no g>0
Sound domain enclosure can still be too wide for useful inference

lemmas.name: Finite certificate soundness and historical retention
premises: Immutable cells B_j cover the static parameter domain
Nested compatible sets F_n subset F_(n-1)
J(F_0) subset A_0 and J(F_n) subset C_n for every certificate
lemmas.claim: A_n=A_(n-1) intersect C_n contains J(F_n) for every prefix and exactly retains all earlier certified cell exclusions.
proof: Nesting implies J(F_n) subset J(F_(n-1)). By induction the latter is contained in A_(n-1).
Certificate soundness gives J(F_n) subset C_n, so J(F_n) is contained in their intersection A_n.
The implementation is exact uint64 bitwise AND. All-domain certificates are identities; duplicates are idempotent; removed bits never return.
At most K strict bit removals are possible. Empty intersection is committed and reported as inconsistent, without a reset. No growing numeric statistic is used.
lemmas.negative_control: With overlapping cells [0,2] and [1,3], theta=3/2 belongs to both. Certificates retaining different singleton cells each cover theta by union but intersect empty. Thus the weaker union-cover premise is insufficient.
limits: Certificate provider soundness is not implemented or proved.
A nonempty mask does not prove exact feasibility.
The result preserves cell exclusions, not Gaussian likelihood, multiplicity or confidence weight.
Provider chronology and valid use of raw samples do not follow from consumer idempotence.
Old local-precision results must not be promoted to hard exclusions.

lemmas.name: Conditional eventual finite refinement
premises: Finite cell domain and L5 certificate premises
T is the acceptable remaining cell set
For every j in A_0 outside T, a finite event k_j supplies a sound certificate omitting j
lemmas.claim: There exists finite N such that A_n subset T for every n>=N.
proof: The unwanted cell set is finite. If it is empty, take N=0. Otherwise let N=max_j k_j.
Every unwanted cell has been excluded by N. Monotone retention from L5 prevents its reappearance.
limits: No universal sample count, elapsed time or existence of informative certificates is proved.
Pointwise exclusions at different times need not establish a whole-cell exclusion.
Finite spatial resolution is a declared limit.
SOC/capacity precision requires sound target ranges across all surviving cells, not merely a small mask cardinality.

composition_status: Open: these lemmas do not establish sound battery certificates, end-to-end SOC/capacity outputs, runtime recovery or full-estimator indefinite stability.

validation.role: Independent exact-reference finite falsification of lemma-to-C correspondence, including an intentional weak-certificate-premise negative control. All-time claims come from the proofs.
